item.title: #Colcapirhua Vecinos realizaron una jornada de limpieza Con el objetivo de prevenir posibles inundaciones ante la proximidad de la temporada de lluvias, el Gobierno Autónomo Municipal de Colcapirhua llevó adelante este domingo 7 de noviembre una Jornada Municipal de Limpieza Integral, con la participación de personal municipal, secretarios generales y vecinos del municipio. item.title: Gaza: Heavy rain inundates thousands of tents
item.description: Heavy rainfall has flooded thousands of tents sheltering displaced Palestinians across the Gaza Strip, including in Deir al-Balah. Residents say overflowing sewage has mixed with the floodwater, further worsening already dire living conditions. Families are struggling to salvage their belongings, building makeshift earthen barriers and trying to drain the water by hand. Many have seen essential items soaked and rendered unusable, adding to the hardship faced by those already displaced. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Tráfico de especies en Costa Rica: una amenaza en uno de los países más biodiversos del mundo
item.description: Un escarabajo, una mariposa morfo e incluso el colmillo de un jaguar. Objetos como estos fueron decomisados a viajeros y comerciantes en Costa Rica. Aunque muchos los adquieren como recuerdos, su compra y transporte sin autorización alimenta el tráfico ilegal de especies. Este delito representa una seria amenaza para la biodiversidad del país. Costa Rica alberga cerca del 6% de las especies del planeta y las autoridades advierten que el comercio ilegal de fauna pone en riesgo este patrimonio natural, clave para sus ecosistemas y para el turismo sostenible. item.title: After years of flooding, Philippine village turns to bamboo, oyster shells and coconut waste to keep rising waters at bay
item.description: Pamarawan village in the Philippines has embraced an innovative coastal defense system to tackle flooding challenges. This initiative incorporates natural materials such as bamboo poles, oyster shells, and coconut husks to fortify against powerful waves and prevent sediment displacement. Remarkably, there have been no flooding incidents reported for almost two years since the project's inception, prompting officials to explore similar setups for other flood-threatened areas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Citizen science program helps find exotic ticks
item.description: Climate change is affecting not only our weather but also the distribution of parasites and the diseases they can carry. One example is the growing presence of Hyalomma ticks in parts of Europe where they were previously uncommon. These ticks are of particular interest because they can transmit Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV), a pathogen that can cause serious, sometimes life-threatening illness in humans. Hyalomma ticks are typically found in warm and dry regions of Africa, Asia and southern Europe. However, they have increasingly been reported farther north, including in… Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: How Democrats used the midterms to turn affordability concerns into ‘green populism’
item.description: From energy prices to datacenters, climate became a cost-of-living issue – and a winning one Climate-forward Democrats swept into power on Tuesday night as a blue tsunami flipped the Senate, House and several governor’s races. Voters were laser-focused on affordability, and experts said Democrats succeeded in linking cost-of-living concerns with rising energy prices, datacenters and, to some extent, the climate crisis.
